title: In Situ Second Harmonic Generation (SHG) Studies of Surface Electric Field on Cobalt Oxide Electrodes
abstract: Cobalt oxide/hydroxide is considered to be an efficient electrochemical (EC) catalyst, and the surface electric field may partly explain this efficiency. The space-charge electric field influences the surface electric field due to electron/hole separation and accumulation in the space-charge layer; charge carriers may then participate in chemical reactions, or the surface electric field may polarize molecules for reactions. abstract: Accurate identification of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) area-specific resistance (ASR) supports durability assessment without frequent <mark>electrochemical impedance</mark> spectroscopy (EIS).
